summary: IMC Rare Earths Ltd, a Brazilian foreign private issuer listed on NYSE American, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 8, 2026 announcing a new shallow, high-grade terbium-rich ionic clay discovery at Block H of its Itarantim rare earth project in Brazil. Hole AD-00555 returned seven meters grading 5,695 ppm TREO, 38 ppm terbium oxide and 258 ppm dysprosium oxide from two meters depth, with leach recoveries of 64%-83%. Block H lies outside the existing 1.1-billion-tonne Mineral Resource. No transaction terms, board recommendation or advisor named; this is an operational exploration update, not a special situation. Watch drill-defined resource growth and Block D step-out results as catalysts.
